objdata.Description: Prepare to withstand the pursuit of time!
objdata.Name: Temporal Strike-day8

Lines.en: Sensors indicate gradual decrease in surface temperature at this location
Lines.zh: 探测器显示此处地表温度在逐渐下降

Lines.en: This will compel local wildlife to undertake collective migration
Lines.zh: 这将迫使野生动物们进行集体大迁徙

Lines.en: User Dave, you are positioned directly within the primary migration corridor
Lines.zh: 用户戴夫，你站的位置正是大迁徙的必经之路

Lines.en: Ooh-hoo! I'll just stuff those critters into my nutty burrito!
Lines.zh: 哦吼，我会把它们当成松鼠夹在我的卷饼里

Lines.en: PENNY! BRING ME THE LAWNMOWER - TIME'S A-WASTIN'!
Lines.zh: 潘妮，快把我的割草机拿来，时间不等人！

StringMultiLanguage.en: The elimination system is about to activate, countdown 30 seconds
StringMultiLanguage.zh: 抹杀系统即将启动，倒计时30秒
